notes: boot% is the share of replicates whose best action equals the point estimate's best action. It measures sampling variability of the fitted models only, not model bias, so it overstates how sure we can be.
split_half compares categories from the even-numbered and odd-numbered replicates; each half has about half of B, so it understates the stability of the full-B categories.
coach_agreement is reported for orientation; the coach evaluation is M7.
